h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Shillong

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Shillong

c: Flat ground is scarce in Shillong, and that is usually the first thing we discuss with a buyer here. As an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Shillong, FunPlay Systems works with schools, colleges, church and community grounds, government offices and housing colonies across the Meghalaya capital. Our Fun Fitness machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2,060 km away, and reach you by road.

Shillong is cool for most of the year and gets very heavy rain from the southwest monsoon. People still walk a great deal, on steep roads and around the few open grounds the town has. A small open air gym on a levelled pad lets them add strength work to that walking. Installation is handled by our own team or a dealer in the northeast, and you approve a layout drawing before anything is made.

richText.heading: Building an outdoor gym on a hill site

c: On a slope, we suggest cutting one or two terraced pads rather than spreading machines along the gradient. Each pad needs a retaining edge and a drain on the uphill side, because run-off in the monsoon is fast and carries soil with it. Grouting the posts into a concrete pad holds the frames firm through months of wet weather.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment be installed on sloping ground in Shillong?
items.a: Yes, once the ground is levelled into a firm pad. We mark the pad size and clear space on the layout drawing so your civil contractor knows exactly how much flat area to prepare.

items.q: Is delivery to Meghalaya possible from Vasai?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment by road to any part of India, including the northeast, and installation is done by our team or a dealer in that region.

items.q: How should the machines be looked after in heavy rain?
items.a: Keep drains around the pad clear, wipe seats and handles after long wet spells and check bolts and bearings every few months. Our after-sales team can guide your caretaker on the phone.
